description: This file provides a set of async functions that serve as wrappers around API endpoints related to filesystem operations and MCP tools. It exposes functions for health checks, directory listing, file read/write, directory creation, renaming, moving, copying, removing files/directories, searching files, and interacting with MCP tools.

methods.name: health()
methods.description: Hit backend health endpoint. Returns status and message.

methods.name: listDir({ path, recursive = false, include_hidden = false })
readFile({ path, offset, length, encoding = "utf-8" })
methods.description: Read file contents by path with optional offset, length, and encoding.

methods.name: writeFile({ path, content, encoding = "utf-8", append = false })
methods.description: Write content to a file, with options for encoding and appending.

methods.name: makeDir({ path, parents = true, exist_ok = true })
methods.description: Create a directory with options for creating parent directories and handling existing directories.

methods.name: movePath({ src, dst, overwrite = false })
methods.description: Move a file or directory from source to destination.

methods.name: copyPath({ src, dst, overwrite = false })
methods.description: Copy a file or directory from source to destination.

methods.name: removePath({ path, recursive = false, force = false })
methods.description: Remove a file or directory, optionally recursively and forcefully.

methods.name: searchFiles({ path, pattern, include_hidden = false })
methods.description: Search for files matching a pattern within a given path.

methods.name: mcpCallTool({ tool_name, args = {} })
methods.description: Call an MCP tool with specified arguments.
